title: Figure 23. The Earth's Associated Lagrangian Points ("Gravity holes" graphic)
description: Color perspective diagram titled "Gravity holes" showing the Sun, Earth's orbit, gravitational field contours and the five Lagrangian points L1-L5, with STEREO A and B spacecraft orbits and a "NOT TO SCALE" tag. Callouts describe each point, e.g. "L1: 1.5 million km from Earth. Ideal location for monitoring the sun" and "L2: ... Permanently shielded from the sun. Home to NASA's WMAP satellite". Caption credits "New Scientist, 9Feb09 and Baker (1967), p.128, Figure 2.2".
